Harper D.: Note: planned priority-bucket failover dry-run + fallback exercise this Mon 2026-05-18 02:00-04:00 UTC. Objective: validate deprioritization and cross-region spill behavior under CPU pressure. Target: dedicated pools in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Hosted API unaffected for non-dedicated routes.

Miguel R.: Outline? Will this trigger customer-facing throttles?

Harper D.: Short plan: 3 ramps of synthetic bulk load to induce CPU > 70% on selected nodes, observe priority rebalancing and spill to region-fallbacks. Expect brief increases in queued latency for bulk routes; paid routes should remain within SLOs. No config pushes other than temporary bucket weights.

Tasha V.: What's the auto-rollback criteria? Also, how are enterprise orgs handled?

Harper D.: Rollback: auto if error_rate > 0.5% for 3m OR p99 > 2.5s for 3m. Enterprise orgs with SLO whitelists are excluded via exclusion list. DM me org-ids if needed.

SRE Ops Bot: Maintenance created: https://internal/maintenance/2330001111 state: scheduled owner: @Harper D. notify: oncall channel: #eng-sre

Oncall Zoe: I'll be on-call. Prechecks I'll run 30m prior: replica lag < 250ms, agent health = green, queue depth < 120. I'll also confirm PagerDuty mapping to PRIORITY-FAILOVER-PD.

Miguel R.: Load client command for reference:
```
./bulk-synth --region us-west-2 --qps 300 --routes file://synth/bulk-routes.json --duration 5m
```

Harper D.: Additions: enable 5% TRACE sampling if p99 > 1s; capture perf profiles for nodes with cpu > 80%. We'll also prewarm KV prefixes after each spill: POST https://infra/api/prewarm -d '{"prefixes":["/org/","/route/"]}'

Tasha V.: Please log which bucket weights we use so runbook gets exact numbers.

Harper D.: Using weights: high=1.0, normal=0.9, bulk=0.4 during test. Will attach the payload to the maintenance ticket.

Oncall Zoe: During each 10m observe window I'll post one-line statuses only: ramp1 started / ramp1 OK / ramp2 throttle observed / ramp2 rollback / finished. Keep thread quiet during observe windows.

Harper D.: Post-run we'll publish a short summary with key metrics and update the priority-buckets runbook. Appreciate the help. :rocket:
